notes: PDF-derived text; reading order was checked and the PK numbers are unambiguous. Only a single headline half-life (~33 h) is given; no absorption/elimination split, no rate constant, no Cmax and no AUC. Half-life was obtained by non-linear regression ('Non-linear regression was used to calculate blood half-life of Fc-apelin-13 and EC50 by Prism 5.01'), with no phase named, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified'. The Results state 'Final blood Fc-apelin-13 levels were about 2.5 +/- 0.2 ug/mL (mean +/- SE, n = 4)' - this is a trough/steady-state level at the end of 4 weeks of daily dosing, NOT a Cmax, so it was not entered in the cmax field. Glucose (2 g/kg i.p.) was given as an IPGTT challenge and is not listed as an agent. Forskolin (10 mM) was an in vitro assay reagent and is not listed as an agent. No sequence was recorded for either apelin species because the body prints only the 18-residue antibody epitope (apelin 60-77aa) and never the apelin-13 sequence itself; deriving apelin-13 from that epitope would be inference. The PEPLIFE2 header lists sequence RPRLSHKGPMPF but was not used as evidence.
